verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. No declaration displays these two evaluations; they are the definitional unfolding of `baseAction`, which is exactly the paper's 𝒦 of (7.6): row 1 of baseAction is -2F·t_θ and rows 2,3 are t_r·(2F e_θ + g), matching 𝒦 = [[0,-2F,0],[2F+RF_R,0,0],[G_R,0,0]] with g = (RF_R, G_R). Rewriting: put F = F_0, g = g_0, ρ = s. For e = tangent ρ B 1 0 one has e 0 = 1 and (tail e) 0 = -ρK_θ, so baseAction F g e = pack (2FρK_θ) (2F e_θ + g) and -𝒦_0 e = (-2F_0 s K_θ, -2F_0 e_θ - g_0), term for term the paper's first pair. For N = tangent ρ B 0 1 one has N 0 = 0 and (tail N) 0 = N_θ, so baseAction F g N = pack (-2F N_θ) 0 and -𝒦_0 N = (2F_0 N_θ, 0), the paper's second pair. Signs, the factor 2, the subscripts θ and the radial/tangential split all agree.
